# GEO report: atlas-roadmaps **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 40/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 23 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 15.33 ÷ 23 × 100 = 67. High = (15.33 + 0) ÷ 23 × 100 = 67. Both numbers are capped at 40 because of a blocker: `robots.txt` blocks Bingbot from the whole site, against your "allow" policy. Everything below was read from code, not measured on a live site. Fixing the Bingbot block lifts the cap, and the score becomes 80. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Let Bingbot crawl the site - **Why it matters:** Bing's crawler is told to skip every page. Bing's index feeds several AI search tools, and your config says search crawlers should be allowed. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:5-6` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: Bingbot` / `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 80 (the cap lifts) ### 2. Point crawlers to your sitemap - **Why it matters:** The sitemap exists, but `robots.txt` never mentions it, so crawlers have no declared place to find it. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:1-9` - **What the code says:** there is no `Sitemap:` line anywhere. Add `Sitemap: https://atlasroadmaps.example/sitemap.xml`. - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 40 alone (the cap still applies). 88 together with item 1. ### 3. Give /pricing its own title, description and canonical - **Why it matters:** In Remix, a route's `meta` replaces the root's. Pricing therefore ends up with no title, no description and no canonical. - **Where:** `app/routes/pricing.tsx:1` - **What the code says:** `export default function Pricing() {…}` with no `meta` export - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 40 alone (the cap still applies). 94 with items 1 and 2, assuming the changelog and features links below are also fixed. With only items 1–3 it is 90. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt valid | Clear | `public/robots.txt` | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed | Problem | `robots.txt:5-6`, Bingbot blocked site-wide. GPTBot (training) blocked, which matches your policy and isn't counted. | | GEO-014 | Routes indexable | Clear | Only `/dashboard` is noindex, which is deliberate and unlisted. | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical | Problem | Pricing has none (3 of 4 routes clear). | | GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Problem | `changelog.tsx:5` loads entries in `useEffect` (3 of 4 routes clear). | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD valid | Not applicable | No JSON-LD found. | | GEO-011 | Sitemap discoverable | Problem | `sitemap.xml` exists but there is no `Sitemap:` line in robots.txt. | | GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Problem | Pricing has no meta (3 of 4 routes clear). `lang="en"` is present. | | GEO-016 | Server-rendered links | Problem | `/features` is reached only through an `onClick` div (2 of 3 routes clear). | | GEO-017 | Snippet restrictions | Clear | No `nosnippet` found. | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Problem | Pricing has no title. No images or buttons without names in the files read. | | GEO-101 | App association files | Not applicable | Not an app profile. | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (info) | Not scored | Absent. | ## Other problems found - **Features is a div, not a link:** `app/routes/home`. See `app/routes/_index.tsx:9`: `
navigate('/features')}>See all features
`. Use `` so it renders a real ``. - **Changelog is empty in server HTML:** `app/routes/changelog.tsx:5`: `useEffect(() => { fetch('/api/changelog')…`. Load it in a Remix `loader` so crawlers see the entries. ## Worth considering - **Add `/features` to the main nav:** `app/root.tsx:7`: `
Pricing Changelog
`. It is a core page and is missing from the nav. - **Back up the integrations claim:** `app/routes/_index.tsx:8`: `Integrates with all the tools you already use.` Name the actual tools in text, which gives readers and machines something concrete to quote. - **Make pricing concrete:** `app/routes/pricing.tsx:1`: `Talk to us for a quote.` Visitors come to learn plan names and prices. Put them in text, and consider `Offer` structured data if they are public. - **Add `` to the sitemap:** `public/sitemap.xml:3-6`. Changelog dates would make real dates available. - **Add Organization/WebSite JSON-LD:** nothing in `app/root.tsx` states the site's identity in machine-readable form. Name and URL are enough. - **Add `charset`, `viewport` and social tags:** `app/root.tsx:2` sets only a title and description. Add `og:title`, `og:description` and `og:image`. - **Give changelog entries their own pages:** `changelog.tsx:6` is a single list. Individual addresses per release would be linkable. - **Say more about the product:** `app/routes/features.tsx:1`: `Timelines, sharing and status updates.` Each feature could have its own heading and a sentence or two on what it does. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Status codes and headers:** redirects and `X-Robots-Tag` set outside the repo aren't visible. A live scan would show them. - **`/api/changelog`:** its handler isn't in the repo, so what it returns is unknown. ## Assumptions - You want search and AI search tools to find this site, as `geo.config.json` says. - Remix v2 `meta` replaces the parent's `meta` rather than merging. - `/dashboard` is intentionally private and was left out of the route counts. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-009`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
